start: A gym owner trying the panel without signing in, on the first screen

steps.action: Start a new gym with a gym name
user_sees: An empty gym opens; no sign-in asked
must_not: A phone number or code demanded first

steps.action: Add a member and take a payment
user_sees: The member and a receipt with a receipt number
must_not: Anything sent to a server

steps.action: Close the browser, open the panel again
user_sees: The same gym, member and receipt
must_not: An empty gym
The first screen again

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: 'Your gym is saved in this browser only.'
must_not: Words that suggest the records are safe online

start: A gym owner whose browser-only gym could not be read earlier; a copy was kept

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: 'A gym this browser couldn’t read is kept here.'
Button 'Download the saved data'
must_not: The kept copy offered when there is none
The kept copy deleted by opening Settings

steps.action: Tap 'Download the saved data'
user_sees: A file with the saved data downloads
must_not: An empty file
The copy removed from the browser after the download

start: A gym owner whose saved gym in this browser is damaged (a save cut off half-way)

steps.action: Open the panel
user_sees: 'We couldn’t read the gym saved in this browser. Your data is kept.'
Three ways on: 'Try again', 'Download the saved data', 'Start a new gym'
must_not: An empty gym opened without a word
The damaged data deleted or written over

steps.action: Tap 'Try again' several times
user_sees: The same message
must_not: A new kept copy made on every try until the browser is full

steps.action: Tap 'Start a new gym'
user_sees: A question first; after yes, an empty gym; the unreadable copy still offered in Settings
must_not: A new gym started with no question
The kept copy gone

steps.action: Add members until the browser has no room left to save
user_sees: A plain message that this could not be saved
must_not: The last member shown as saved
The whole gym lost

start: A gym owner with the browser-only gym open in two tabs

steps.action: Add a member in tab one
user_sees: The member in tab one
must_not: A save that drops something tab two saved before

steps.action: Add another member in tab two without reloading it
user_sees: Both members in the gym afterwards
must_not: Tab two saving its old copy over tab one’s member

steps.action: Put the gym online (sign in)
user_sees: The gym’s records go online; the browser’s own copy is moved aside, not deleted
must_not: The browser copy deleted before the records are online
Two gyms shown

start: A gym owner using a browser-only gym on a shared computer

steps.action: Another person opens the same browser profile and the panel address
user_sees: The gym opens without any sign-in
must_not: Words anywhere that say the gym is protected by a sign-in while it is not online

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: 'Your gym is saved in this browser only.' and 'Right now your members and payments are only in this browser.'
must_not: The records found on a server or another device
No word that clearing the browser loses the gym

start: An owner running the real gym in this browser only (never put online)

steps.action: Open the panel in the morning
user_sees: The gym as left last night; no sign-in
must_not: A sign-in page
An empty gym

steps.action: Add members, sell plans, take payments through the day
user_sees: Every change stays after a reload; receipt numbers follow one another
must_not: A receipt number used twice
A change lost on reload

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data
user_sees: 'Saved in this browser only.'
A card offering to put the gym online
must_not: A count of records that differs from what is in the gym

start: An owner with a kept copy of a gym this browser could not read

steps.action: Open Settings and tap 'Download the saved data'
user_sees: 'A gym this browser couldn’t read is kept here.'; a file downloads
must_not: The button missing although a copy is kept
The file empty

start: An owner whose browser-only gym was saved by a newer version of the panel than the one now open

steps.action: Open the panel
user_sees: 'This gym was saved by a newer version of MettleUp (v{n}; this app reads v{n}). Reload the page to get the new version. Your data is safe.'
must_not: The gym replaced with an empty one
The newer data cut down to what the old version understands

steps.action: Reload
user_sees: The new version opens the gym
must_not: A kept copy made on every reload

steps.action: Open the panel when the saved gym is damaged
user_sees: 'We couldn’t read the gym saved in this browser. Your data is kept.'
must_not: The first-time welcome as if the gym was gone

start: An owner of a browser-only gym with real members

steps.action: Cancel a receipt, then undo a plan cancellation
user_sees: Both changes stay after a reload
must_not: The old state back after a reload

steps.action: Put the gym online from the Settings card
user_sees: The same members, plans and receipts online; this browser’s copy set aside under another name
must_not: Members missing online
The browser copy thrown away

steps.action: Sign out later on this device
user_sees: The sign-in page or an empty start
must_not: The set-aside copy opened as if it were the live gym

start: An owner of a browser-only gym who clears the browser’s data or changes phone

steps.action: Read Settings before doing it
user_sees: 'Your gym is saved in this browser only.'
'Right now your members and payments are only in this browser.'
must_not: No warning that the gym exists nowhere else

steps.action: Open the panel on the new phone
user_sees: No gym: a first screen
must_not: Words that blame the owner or suggest the data can be brought back from MettleUp
